user.title: Create your Matterbase inventory
user.description: Inventory is stored privately in Home Assistant. QR scanning and OCR run locally in your browser. No separate container, server URL, or cloud service is needed. Existing Docker backups can be imported after setup.

data.pairing_help: Show optional Home Assistant pairing instructions

abort.single_instance_allowed: Matterbase is already configured. To migrate an external connector, export its inventory, remove that integration entry, then add Matterbase again and import the backup. Removing the connector does not delete its server inventory.
